changes: 2.4.1: enemies and bosses wear the biome — a shader skin over every model (Ember Works: charred shell with pulsing lava veins; Cryo Vault: frost on the upper surfaces with glints; Toxin Marsh: slime and glowing toxic spots; Void Core: violet rim glow and star specks) plus matching particles (embers, frost flakes, drops, motes); type colours and glow stay, so types are still told apart; visual only
2.4.1: tests/biome-shots.mjs spawns a ring of enemies and the boss in every biome and fails on shader compile errors

2.4.0: 5 biomes instead of 19, and the biome changes after every boss again (every wave since 2.1): waves 1–5 Neon Yard, then Ember Works, Cryo Vault, Toxin Marsh and Void Core in a seeded order, one per boss cycle; Endless reaches the fifth at wave 21

2.4.0: each biome looks different, not just differently coloured — own floor (neon grid, basalt with lava seams, frozen sheet, mud and murky water, hex tiles over a starfield), own props on the same collision shapes (pylons/crates, chimneys/machines, crystal clusters/ice blocks, mushrooms/dead trees/logs, floating obelisks/monoliths), own border, ambient particles, sun colour and fog

2.4.0: each biome plays differently — Ember Works favours heavy and explosive enemies, Cryo Vault has a slick floor (you drift) and shielded/ranged enemies, Toxin Marsh swarms, Void Core fast teleporters; hazard biomes place two extra hazards per wave (was one)

2.4.0: 7 weapons instead of 21 — the 14 weapons of the 2.0–2.2 packs were variants of the originals; saves that owned one get that original plus the price difference in shards (or the full price if they own it), selected weapon and unfinished run follow, a toast says what changed; their 12 evolutions and the 15/20-weapon milestones are gone, Full Spectrum needs 4 weapons, World Walker wave 21
2.4.0: double-tapping the move side no longer dashes; the DASH button (Space/Shift on a keyboard) does

2.4.0: tests — deep test checks weapon/biome counts, the boss-cycle route, hazards per biome, Cryo Vault grip, enemy mix and save migration; world audit checks the new route; full QA checks the migration of the real 2.2.2/2.3.1 saves (Ion Repeater → Arc Caster); tests/biome-shots.mjs screenshots every biome (part of npm run screens)
